materialBasis: Native sRGB except source-photograph dark optical cover, case and PCB. No invented exact material properties.
assemblyNotes: Native base assembly, proper identity millimetre transform, complete241components.
limitations: All 241 native components (238 solids and three open shells) from the exact base assembly are retained. Native component geometry and coordinates are not scaled or repositioned.

SKU31203 is the base assembly without soldered headers; SKU31201 (-M) has two soldered 1×11 headers. Both exact official archives and drawings are independently retained by their corresponding models.

Native case part2 has the reused library name ESP32-S3-TOUCH-LCD-1_47-CASE. This is a mechanical library label in the explicitly named C6 archive, not evidence of an S3 controller or interchangeable complete PCB.
The supplied assembly does not declare a shipping PCB revision. The fixed repository and archive retrieval dates are source dates, not release-date certification.
The PDF labels cover viewing area17.75×32.93 mm, not LCD active area. Native LCD component0 face46 provides the separate17.39×32.35 mm active region with2.30 mm corner radius, centered at XY0/Z1.85.

The live framebuffer preserves the native active region and is projected onto touch viewing face component1 face40 at Z3.20 plus0.008 mm rendering offset. The native raised cover rim remains at3.25; the rendering offset is not a physical layer.

Outer case24.55×44.50 mm and native complete Y44.773315 mm differ because USB protrudes beyond the case. Source geometry is preserved; drawing dimensions are not used to rescale the complete assembly.

Native cover component1 includes flex and reaches4.35 mm overall depth; this is not the glass laminate thickness. Native PCB24.071610×44.023628×1.200000 mm is reported independently of case dimensions.

BOOT is native component7 and binds to boot/GPIO9 active-low. The retained overview repeatedly calls BOOT GPIO8; the official schematic BOOT net at GPIO9 is authoritative for this mapping. RESET component8 remains visible and unbound.

Native CAD colors are approximate material references. Cover, case and PCB are darkened using official photographs. The exact supplied case alone is recolorable; PCB, cover, display and connectors are excluded from shell presets.

Optical text-to-USB registration and hardware fit are not calibrated on a physical device. The native portrait geometry and172×320 framebuffer are retained without a claimed optical orientation acceptance.
No source stock screenshot is substituted for the live framebuffer. Source photos remain unchanged references; no battery, cable or extra accessory is invented.
No lost pre-reset model, archive or historical acceptance receipt is reused.
The base STEP omits soldered headers. A supplied loose header photograph is retained as package evidence but no header is installed in this model.
